rule: The report's delivery-grade roadmap (PLAN F7 item 3, area 13(e)). Each capability gap finding and each lever finding belongs to one workstream; a workstream's start, duration, owner, dependencies, milestones and value come from its findings, and its effort from the value model's lever effort plus a per-level heuristic for gaps without a quantified lever. Activities, KPIs, prerequisites and risks are LTM heuristics (CLM-FIN-177) except where a claim is cited.

workstreams.name: Allocation, cost data and reporting
workstreams.objective: Every cost has an accountable owner, complete data and a report that reaches the owner in time to act.
activities: Agree the allocation policy: account and project structure, mandatory tags or labels, and rules for shared and untaggable costs
Bring every provider's billing export (FOCUS where available) into one dataset and reconcile it to the invoices
Publish cost by owner and route anomaly alerts to the owner with an agreed response time
Show back, then charge back, cost to business units once allocation is stable

kpis.name: Share of spend allocated to an accountable owner, measured by cost
Time from an unexpected cost increase to the owner knowing about it
Share of invoices reconciled to the cost data each month

prerequisites: Read access to every provider's billing export
A named owner for each account, subscription or project
risks: Tagging coverage measured by resource count overstates allocation by cost
Shared platform costs left unallocated stall chargeback

workstreams.name: Commitment portfolio, licences and SaaS
workstreams.objective: Buy commitments against steady usage after the usage changes are planned, and stop paying for unused licences and seats.
activities: Baseline coverage and utilisation of commitments by provider, measured by cost
Sequence purchases after scheduling, rightsizing and Spot moves, in tranches with expiry dates spread
Move interruption-tolerant workloads not covered by commitments to Spot or preemptible capacity
Reclaim or re-harvest unused licences and seats at renewal

kpis.name: Commitment coverage of eligible usage, by cost
Unused licence and seat cost at each renewal

prerequisites: Allocation good enough to see steady usage by owner
Finance agreement to commit for one or three years
risks: Committing before usage is reduced locks in waste
Concentrated expiry dates create renewal cliffs

workstreams.name: Rightsizing, scheduling and clean-up
workstreams.objective: Pay only for the capacity that is used, when it is used.
activities: Switch non-production environments off outside working hours by default
Act on provider-tool rightsizing and idle-resource recommendations on a fixed cadence, with owners
Set storage lifecycle policies and remove orphaned volumes, snapshots and addresses
Make expected cost a criterion in architecture reviews

kpis.name: Share of non-production compute scheduled off outside working hours
Provider-tool recommendations actioned within the agreed cycle

prerequisites: Owners for the resources to change
risks: Changes made without owners are reverted
Savings counted twice across rightsizing and commitments

workstreams.name: Kubernetes and AI cost management
workstreams.objective: Allocate and right-size cluster and GPU spend like any other workload.
activities: Allocate cluster cost to namespaces and teams by requested and used CPU and memory
Tune requests and autoscaling to measured use
Track GPU utilisation and shut down idle model endpoints

kpis.name: Used versus requested CPU and memory in clusters
Average GPU utilisation and idle endpoint spend

prerequisites: Cluster cost allocation data (provider split cost data or an open-source allocator)
risks: Requests cut below need cause throttling
AI spend grows faster than the controls

workstreams.name: Forecasting, budgets and unit economics
workstreams.objective: Plan spend from business drivers and judge it by what it delivers.
activities: Estimate the running cost of new workloads before they go ahead
Forecast from business drivers and planned changes; track variance monthly
Give teams budgets with alerts and a review when they are exceeded
Agree unit costs (per customer, transaction or unit of output) and report their trend

kpis.name: Unit cost trend for the agreed business units

prerequisites: A business volume measure the finance team accepts
risks: Unit costs built on unallocated spend mislead decisions

workstreams.name: FinOps operating model and governance
workstreams.objective: Someone is accountable for technology spend, with a mandate, a cadence and policies that hold.
activities: Appoint an accountable FinOps owner with a written mandate and an executive sponsor
Run a regular cost review with engineering and finance, with decisions recorded
Enforce cost policies automatically (tags, allowed regions and sizes, budgets)
Train engineers, product owners and finance staff; reassess the practice yearly

kpis.name: Capabilities at or above their target level
Share of cost reviews held on schedule with decisions recorded

prerequisites: Agreement between finance and technology on who decides
risks: A FinOps team without a mandate becomes a reporting function
Policies enforced without exceptions block delivery
